meta.description: A good model: golden SQL plus realistic repaired first attempts

What was our total revenue across all ti:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
```
How many orders are there for each statu:
```sql
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY order_status
```

```sql
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY status
```
What is the average order value for comp:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM ( SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))) AS order_total FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.id) t
```
How many units have we sold in each prod:
```sql
SELECT c.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name
```
What was total revenue last quarter?:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'complete' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
```

```sql

```
Show quarterly revenue for 2025, labelin:
```sql
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date)::date AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
```

What was total revenue in the second hal:

By what percentage did revenue grow from:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01') - SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01')) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
```
Who are our top 5 customers by total rev:
```sql
SELECT c.email, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.email ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.email LIMIT 5
```
What is our revenue by customer country?:
```sql
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country
```
Which product category generates the mos:


Which products had no sales at all last:
```sql
SELECT p.name AS product FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = p.id AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01')
```
How many customers did each signup chann:

How much revenue did we give up in disco:

What percentage of all order line items:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(discount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_discounted FROM order_items
```
What are the top 5 products by revenue?:
```sql
SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.name LIMIT 5
```
Which month had the highest revenue? Sho:
```sql
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
```
Which products had the biggest revenue d:
```sql
SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01'), 0), 2) AS prev_quarter_revenue, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'), 0), 2) AS last_quarter_revenue, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01'), 0), 2) AS change FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY change ASC, p.name LIMIT 5
```
